nodes.name: types.go
nodes.summary: Declares annotation keys, resource kind constants, key usage values, and signature algorithm constants shared across the internal cert-manager APIs.

nodes.name: types_certificate.go
nodes.summary: Internal API types for Certificate resources, covering the certificate spec, private key settings, keystores, name constraints, status, and conditions.

nodes.name: Certificate
nodes.summary: Certificate resource requesting an X.509 certificate and storing the resulting key pair in a Secret.

nodes.name: CertificateList
nodes.summary: List wrapper for Certificate resources.

nodes.name: CertificateSpec
nodes.summary: Desired certificate properties: subject and SANs, issuer reference, duration, renewal, private key, keystores, and output formats.

nodes.name: OtherName
nodes.summary: Additional subject alternative name encoded as an OID and value pair.

nodes.name: CertificatePrivateKey
nodes.summary: Private key algorithm, size, encoding, rotation policy, and re-use settings for issued certificates.

nodes.name: CertificateAdditionalOutputFormat
nodes.summary: Additional output format (for example PKCS#12 or JKS) requested for the issued certificate.

nodes.name: X509Subject
nodes.summary: X.509 subject fields such as organization, country, locality, and serial number.

nodes.name: CertificateKeystores
nodes.summary: Keystore outputs (JKS and PKCS#12) generated alongside the certificate.

nodes.name: JKSKeystore
nodes.summary: JKS keystore configuration including the password secret reference, alias, and creation policy.

nodes.name: PKCS12Keystore
nodes.summary: PKCS#12 keystore configuration including the password secret reference, profile, and creation policy.

nodes.name: CertificateStatus
nodes.summary: Observed certificate state: conditions, renewal time, revision, and failure information.

nodes.name: CertificateCondition
nodes.summary: A single condition describing the lifecycle state of a Certificate.

nodes.name: CertificateSecretTemplate
nodes.summary: Annotations and labels applied to the Secret that holds the issued certificate.

nodes.name: NameConstraints
nodes.summary: X.509 name constraints listing permitted and excluded DNS names and IP ranges.

nodes.name: NameConstraintItem
nodes.summary: A single permitted or excluded name-constraint entry.

nodes.name: types_certificaterequest.go
nodes.summary: Internal API types for CertificateRequest resources, including the CSR spec, status, and approval/denial conditions.

nodes.name: CertificateRequest
nodes.summary: CertificateRequest resource carrying a certificate signing request for an issuer to sign.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestList
nodes.summary: List wrapper for CertificateRequest resources.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestSpec
nodes.summary: Signing request details: CSR bytes, issuer reference, duration, key usages, and username/groups.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestStatus
nodes.summary: Observed request state: conditions, issued certificate, CA flag, and failure time.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestCondition
nodes.summary: A single condition on a CertificateRequest such as approved, denied, or ready.

nodes.name: types_issuer.go
nodes.summary: Internal API types for Issuer and ClusterIssuer resources and their backends, including ACME, CA, Vault, Venafi, and self-signed configurations.

nodes.name: ClusterIssuer
nodes.summary: Cluster-scoped issuer resource that can sign certificate requests for any namespace.

nodes.name: ClusterIssuerList
nodes.summary: List wrapper for ClusterIssuer resources.

nodes.name: Issuer
nodes.summary: Namespaced issuer resource that signs certificate requests.

nodes.name: IssuerList
nodes.summary: List wrapper for Issuer resources.

nodes.name: IssuerSpec
nodes.summary: Issuer specification holding the selected issuer backend configuration.

nodes.name: IssuerConfig
nodes.summary: Union of supported issuer backends: ACME, CA, Vault, Venafi, and self-signed.

nodes.name: VenafiIssuer
nodes.summary: Venafi issuer configuration selecting either the TPP or Cloud backend.

nodes.name: VenafiTPP
nodes.summary: Venafi TPP endpoint and access credentials.

nodes.name: VenafiCloud
nodes.summary: Venafi Cloud endpoint and access credentials.

nodes.name: SelfSignedIssuer
nodes.summary: Self-signed issuer configuration, which requires no additional fields.

nodes.name: VaultIssuer
nodes.summary: HashiCorp Vault issuer configuration including server, path, namespace, and authentication.

nodes.name: VaultAuth
nodes.summary: Union of Vault authentication methods: token secret, AppRole, Kubernetes, or client certificate.

nodes.name: VaultAppRole
nodes.summary: Vault AppRole authentication credentials with role ID and secret reference.

nodes.name: VaultClientCertificateAuth
nodes.summary: Vault client certificate authentication with mount path and secret reference.

nodes.name: VaultKubernetesAuth
nodes.summary: Vault Kubernetes authentication using a service account and role.

nodes.name: ServiceAccountRef
nodes.summary: Reference to a Kubernetes service account used for authentication.

nodes.name: CAIssuer
nodes.summary: CA issuer configuration with a signing secret and optional CRL distribution points.

nodes.name: IssuerStatus
nodes.summary: Observed issuer state and conditions.

nodes.name: IssuerCondition
nodes.summary: A single condition describing the readiness of an Issuer.

nodes.name: zz_generated.conversion.go
nodes.summary: Generated conversion functions translating between internal cert-manager types and the public v1 API types, including scheme registration.

nodes.name: RegisterConversions
nodes.summary: Registers the generated conversion functions between internal and v1 cert-manager API types with the conversion scheme.

nodes.name: clusterissuer.go
nodes.summary: Admission validation entry points for ClusterIssuer resources that delegate to the shared issuer spec validation.

nodes.name: ValidateClusterIssuer
nodes.summary: Validates a ClusterIssuer spec through the shared issuer spec validation.

nodes.name: ValidateUpdateClusterIssuer
nodes.summary: Validates updates to a ClusterIssuer using the shared issuer spec validation.
